title: CareLevo pairing/connection fails on Android OS 13
body:
[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30210642/AndroidAPS.log)

### Build version
- 4.0.0-dev-a (d888) (branch: carelevo)

### Time of issue
- Reproduced repeatedly during testing

### Environment
- Branch: carelevo
- Android OS version: 13
- Comparison result: connection flow appears to work normally on Android 14 and above

### Steps to reproduce
1. Open the CareLevo plugin in AAPS
2. Start pairing/connection with the patch
3. Proceed through the normal pairing and connection flow

### Expected behavior
- Pairing and connection should complete successfully.

### Actual behavior
- Pairing/connection does not complete properly on Android OS 13.
- In our testing, the same connection flow appears to work normally on Android 14 and above.

### Logs
- Full logs are attached.
- Relevant excerpt:

11:52:39.246 [DefaultDispatcher-worker-1] E/PUMPCOMM: [CarelevoPatchConnectViewModel$startConnect$1.invokeSuspend():268]: newBle.pairing FAILED
app.aaps.pump.carelevo.ble.gatt.GattDiscoveryException: disconnected
	at app.aaps.pump.carelevo.ble.gatt.BleTransportGattConnection.onConnectionStateChanged(BleTransportGattConnection.kt:172)
	at app.aaps.pump.carelevo.ble.CarelevoBleTransportImpl$gattCallback$1.onConnectionStateChange(CarelevoBleTransportImpl.kt:83)
	at android.bluetooth.BluetoothGatt$1$5.run(BluetoothGatt.java:363)
	at android.bluetooth.BluetoothGatt.runOrQueueCallback(BluetoothGatt.java:1003)
	at android.bluetooth.BluetoothGatt.-$$Nest$mrunOrQueueCallback(BluetoothGatt.java:0)
	at android.bluetooth.BluetoothGatt$1.onClientConnectionState(BluetoothGatt.java:358)
	at android.bluetooth.IBluetoothGattCallback$Stub.onTransact(IBluetoothGattCallback.java:135)
	at android.os.Binder.execTransactInternal(Binder.java:1321)
	at android.os.Binder.execTransact(Binder.java:1280)
```

comments.body: I tested it, but in our environment the isBonded change alone was not enough. I opened a PR with additional changes, including Android OS 13 handling and scan selection updates: [3f92eb1]
